Name: Uma Musume Horses
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Uma Musume Horses[/b]

Bring the charm of [i]Uma Musume: Pretty Derby[/i] to Stardew Valley!
This mod transforms your horse into one of many beloved Uma Musume characters.
Choose your favorite through [b]GMCM[/b] or use the new [b]AT version[/b] to have multiple Uma Musume horses at the same time!

[b][u]Available Characters[/u][/b]
All characters previously planned have now been fully added:

• Gold Ship
• Haru Urara
• Vodka
• El Condor Pasa
• Oguri Cap
• Special Week
• Silence Suzuka
• Daiwa Scarlet
• Mejiro McQueen
• Kitasan Black
• Tokai Teio

[b]Coming in future updates:[/b]
• Agnes Tachyon
• Symboli Rudolf
• Satono Diamond
• Tormenta China (31 Minutos – Uma Musume style)

[b][u]How It Works (CP Version)[/u][/b]

Open the [b]Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] to choose which Uma Musume your horse will take the appearance of.
Switch characters anytime you want.

[b][u]NEW! Alternative Textures Version[/u][/b]
A complete [b]Alternative Textures[/b] version is now included!

This version allows you to:
• Have multiple Uma Musume horses at the same time
• Switch appearances using the [b]AT Scissors[/b] in Robin’s shop
• Use it in [b]singleplayer or multiplayer[/b] (each player can select a different skin)

[b]How to get more horses (vanilla-friendly method):[/b]

[b]Build extra Cabins[/b] from Robin.
After the extra Cabin exists, the option to build another [b]Stable[/b] becomes available.
[b]Build the Stable[/b]
You can now [b]demolish the Cabin[/b]; the horse will remain.
Use the [b]AT Scissors[/b] on each horse to assign different Uma Musume skins.

[i]Note:[/i] Stardew only offers additional Stables if there’s at least one extra Cabin on the farm. That’s why you must place a Cabin first, then build the Stable. Repeat as needed for more horses.

Apply different Uma Musume skins to each one through AT

This is the recommended version if you want a full Uma Musume “stable”!

[b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]
GMCM support (CP version)
Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+
Compatible with mods that do NOT replace the same horse sprites
AT version works in multiplayer

[b][u]Credits[/u][/b]
Sprites and mod by [b]Amichwan[/b].
Inspired by the world of [i]Uma Musume: Pretty Derby[/i].
